document.title: Finite-time blow-up for the Navier–Stokes equations
document.credit: Adapted from the paper by Alpöge and Buckmaster. Prepared by Will Cook with AI assistance.

notes: The abstract states the hypothesis of the localization theorem before describing how the rescaled gradients follow the reference flow.
The proof outline explains why spatial localization and heat flow together give compactness and how a change of frame removes the periodic pressure difference.
The certificate and computation sections identify the exact hypotheses used by the estimates and place the original figures alongside their explanations.
